sources.title: RBI MPC meeting highlights: Repo rate hiked to 5.5%
sources.snippet:
The Reserve Bank of India announced its bi-monthly monetary policy on Wednesday (October 7, 2026), unanimously deciding to increase the repo rate by 25 basis points, from 5.25% to 5.50%. The key rate hike after nearly three-and-a half years comes as inflation pressures rise due to the continuing West Asia conflict.
Repo rate was cut to 5.25% in December 2025 and since then it was put on hold till today.

# RBI hikes repo rate by 25bps: What it means and how it impacts you | All FAQs answered
## The RBI's 25-basis-point repo rate hike on 7 October is aimed at curbing inflation. This increase could raise borrowing costs for loans, affecting monthly repayments, while potential adjustments to deposit rates may also occur.
[**Sounak Mukhopadhyay**](https://www.livemint.com/authors/sounak-mukhopadhyay)
Published 7 Oct 2026, 10:12 PM IST
On 7 October, the Reserve Bank of India announced a 25-basis-point repo rate hike. It can affect loans, deposits and household budgets.

...

## RBI hikes repo rate: [...truncated by sanitizer]

answer: India's current repo rate is 5.50% [5]. The Reserve Bank of India's MPC raised the policy repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50% on October 7, 2026 [5]. This was the first rate hike after the rate had been cut to 5.25% in December 2025 [5]. The rate had been kept on hold at the next four MPC meetings before that hike [5].
